flushPolicy.note: theoreticalMaxGroupCommitPerSec = serial.fsyncsPerSec × batchMax (full batches). Parallel must not be used as this ceiling.

serial.pattern: one writer; write(batchMax NDJSON lines); fsyncSync; wait; repeat — matches trigger-journal group_commit

parallel.pattern: 8 fio jobs; each write+fsync; aggregate IOPS — NOT the group_commit ceiling

overwriteDiagnostic.note: Not the board pattern — kept only to explain prior inflated probes that rewrote one offset.

reading.verdict: Serial single-writer fsyncs/sec still far above ~4k. Board rates well below theoreticalMaxGroupCommitPerSec are software headroom (likely CPU in the write/drain path) — not proven disk-bound. Profile the drain on both systems.
reading.action: Do not call ClawQL-vs-Ontologiql gaps disk-shaped until both are measured against this serial ceiling on one host. Keep parallel as multi-writer headroom only.
reading.bothSystems: Ontologiql must run the same serial_board_matched probe (one writer, one sync in flight, batch-then-fsync) on the shared host before claiming disk-bound.
reading.priorMistake: An earlier probe that looked like ~40k fsync/s was overwrite-same-offset / parallel-capable and overstated single-writer capacity. Retracted as the group_commit ceiling.
